Stormterror: Dvalin, the Dragon of the East, corrupted by the Abyss Order and freed by the Traveler in the Prologue.
Wolf of the North: Andrius, the Lupus Boreas. A fallen god of blizzards who now watches over the wolves of Wolvendom.
Childe: Tartaglia in his Foul Legacy form, fought beneath the Golden House in Liyue.
Azhdaha: The Lord of Vishaps, Zhongli's old friend, sealed when erosion took his mind.
Signora: La Signora, the Crimson Witch of Flames, who dueled the Traveler before the Raiden Shogun.
Guardian of Eternity: The Raiden Shogun's puppet, fighting to keep Ei's old vision of eternity.
Shouki no Kami, the Prodigal: Scaramouche inside the god-machine built by the sages of Sumeru.
Guardian of Apep's Oasis: The guardian of the dying Dendro Dragon Sovereign, Apep.
All-Devouring Narwhal: The beast from beyond the sky that Childe fought in the Primordial Sea.
The Knave: Arlecchino, Fourth of the Harbingers, with the Crimson Moon's power unleashed.
Lord of Eroded Primal Fire: The Abyss-corroded remains of the Pyro Dragon Sovereign beneath Natlan.
